cards.rationale: PEB83 PDF page3 visually prints Chicago, Ill., April18,1950, addresses The President/The White House, identifies Executive Order10117 and the Western Carriers/Switchmen dispute, and says submit herewith. The printed signatories are Roger I. McDonough, Mart J. O’Malley and Gordon S. Watkins. Raw PDF is held and rehashed; pdftotext pages1-5 is blank except form feeds. Separately attributed Tesseract OCR matches the letter content sufficiently for this proposition; page image governs. No receipt stamp, White House docket, delivery acknowledgment or legal cessation conclusion is supplied.

PEB86 PDF page2 visually dates its signed letter July6,1950, addresses the President/The White House, and says tender herewith. Its printed EO number is10138; that is a source-print conflict, not OCR. PDF page3 opening instead identifies Executive Order10130 dated June6,1950 and names the Boston & Albany/Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen dispute; lower narrative separately dates member designation June15,1950. Annual FY1951 case A-3392/PEB86 narrative independently says EO dated June6 and report dated July6. Held FR working text separately shows EO10130 June6. Additional printed-source conflict observed: reproduced order closing dateline on report PDF page3 says July6,1950. Preserve this too if using that reproduction for order-date/identity evidence. Text-layer July6,1960 is OCR; image says1950. Uphold this card’s dated-letter facts only, not authentication of a corrected original or receipt.

The core dated-letter proposition is supported: PEB67 PDF page2 visually says March10,1949, submits herewith, and expressly distinguishes member appointment January24 from EO10029 dated January19. PDF pages3-4 visually repeat that chronology and30-day extension; March10 on PDF page4 also dates board receipt of the parties’ joint settlement certificate, not Presidential report receipt. Annual FY1949 extracted HTML text says36 days in case A-2913, but no annual PDF/page image was held/available at the blind cutoff. Thus I cannot uphold the unqualified assertion that the annual printed source describes36 rather than an OCR error. Replace that qualification with attributed HTML/OCR text says36; printed annual reading unverified, or supply the annual image. No extension duration or White House receipt is approved.

The index created value June15,1950 describes the PEB86 entry; it does not establish EO10130 issuance. PDF page3 expressly identifies EO10130 dated June6 and separately says that on June15 the President designated Jasper, Stocking and Jackson to constitute the board. Held FR working text and FY1951 annual case narrative also identify June6. Letter PDF page2 visibly prints10138 while body prints10130; therefore a source identity discrepancy exists and must be disclosed. Correcting that printed conflict silently is impermissible.

A letter bearing March10,1949 and saying submit herewith is not proof the President or White House received the report that day. No receipt record/stamp/acknowledgment examined supplies actual Presidential receipt. PDF page4’s March10 received language concerns the chairman receiving a joint certificate from the dispute parties; its actor/object is different. Dated letter, report date, board receipt of settlement certificate and Presidential receipt must remain distinct.
